label_source: DEVELOPER_AUDIT_2026-11-05/06 (prepared by the coding assistant from the saved source threads; not confirmed by a team lead)
scope: data/experiments/threadsense_full_v1 (81 cards); a label applies only while its member set and saved source messages match source_sha256
method: Audited, input-bound labels: no automatic relevance classification. A label applies only while its member set and saved source messages match source_sha256, and excludes a card only when its evidence statements are SUPPORTED; an unlabelled or changed card stays in the brief.

relevance_values.MIXED: social wording with substantive project content; belongs in the brief
relevance_values.SOCIAL_ONLY: pure social exchange; excluded from the brief when no review reason, flag, queue item or outstanding step applies
relevance_values.ROUTINE_NO_FINDING: routine exchange without a useful ongoing finding; history under the same conditions
relevance_values.ROUTINE_ADMIN: administrative exchange with no project finding; history even while still open, with its open status kept, when no review reason, flag or queue item applies
relevance_values.ROUTINE_NOTICE: time-bound notices; history only when every notice ended at or before the briefing cutoff (latest possible end), never read as completion
